editorial.blurb: Mako's omakase experience showcases impeccable technique and attentive service, with standout moments when the chef's passion and wine pairings elevate the meal.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive on time—the restaurant runs a strict seating schedule and rushes latecomers through courses. Request Chef Doug or Devon for personalized service and wine pairing guidance if you're uncertain about pairings.
